name: Hiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: In his days Hiel of Bethel rebuilds Jericho, laying its foundation in his firstborn Abiram and setting up its gates in his youngest Segub, according to the word spoken by Joshua.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Hiel the Bethelite
cases.charge: Building Jericho again under the oath Joshua adjured before the Lord
cases.preview: When the walls of Jericho fell and the city was burned, Joshua laid an oath on Israel before the Lord: the man who rose up and rebuilt Jericho would lay its foundation at the cost of his firstborn…
